rule: A branch is 'real' only if every reading in it is the stage's genuine wording and the grouping of stages is right; 'noise' if an OCR misreading, an editorial note, a paragraph marker or text of another article makes or falsifies it (e.g. 'bveryoug 3', 'ell', 'para', E/CN.4/95's note 'The Drafting Committee did not have the time...'); 'artifact' if the alignment puts unrelated words in one column, so that stages seem to share a reading they do not (a coincidental 'the', 'of', 'and', 'to', or a word moved elsewhere in the sentence shown as dropped).
